Overview

Dongguan is a city in Guangdong with a population of 10,466,000. A manufacturing powerhouse in the Pearl River Delta, known for electronics production, furniture manufacturing, and rapid urbanization. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
